moods.mood_description: Conquer Kalinga and prove the throne legitimate through glory
The empire's eastern coast and Ashok's pride
The victor breaks while the defeated still breathe
Military glory versus the humanity of the conquered
The river turns red; the silence after battle
Empire requires submission; order requires fear
A nun asks what he will do with the peace he has bought
The river will return in dreams and edicts
He wins the kingdom and loses the man he was
